How many candidates deserve a chance?
When the model samples its next token, it can pick among all
— including thousands of nonsensical ones — or among a shortlist. Top-k keeps a fixed number. Top-p (Holtzman et al.,
) keeps the fewest tokens whose probabilities add up to p: one when the model is sure, many when it is not.
